capabilities: Add child and sibling cards with Tab and Enter
Move the selection between parent, child and sibling cards
Tidy a tree into a chosen layout direction
Copy the parent colour and find free space for new cards
extras: Nine commands are free; six Pro features (balanced and radial layouts, outline export, tree from a note, depth colours, branch move) need a GitHub Sponsors payment of $5 a month or $15 once and a GitHub sign-in. No network requests are made until sign-in.
problem: Growing a mind map on an Obsidian canvas means placing and connecting cards by hand, which is slow and leaves cards overlapping.
summary: Keyboard-driven mind-map builder for Obsidian canvas that adds child and sibling cards and tidies the tree layout.
